products.title: ASK-1000 Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headset
products.descr:
This active noise cancelling headset delivers hybrid ANC that reduces ambient noise up to 35dB. The 40-hour playtime covers multi-day travel. It supports multipoint pairing across two devices.

  • Hybrid ANC up to 35dB
  • Bluetooth 5.3, low latency
  • 40h battery, USB-C fast charge
The flagship ANC series for business and travel users.
